expected: Replace the 'unrecorded use = unresolved gap' rule with evidence-based outcomes.
lesson: Four outcomes: exhausted on a date; within (order date, R]; not in force with use unknown as an interval to the reason date; open. Most waivers will stay open on use unless the Official Register is fetched (archive.org/HathiTrust were unreachable from the cloud session; a GitHub job may reach them).
result: CSC annual reports print and count waivers but never record use (four read in full). Use can be dated by the Official Register (odd years 1901-1921, an interval) or later orders naming the person; NARA St. Louis cards are offline. No general rewrite (EO 7916, 8743, 9830, 10577) ends these waivers; EO 3461 (1921) expressly revokes listed war-emergency appointment orders; EO 209 (1903) is a reason only for 1900-02 special rules; latest possible death bounds the end only when a quoted fact fixes a minimum age. Reviewers found misclassified members (rule amendments, class orders, land orders). Rule approved after R5-R7.
tried: Research and rewrite of TR-CS-WAIVER (1,530 one-person civil-service waivers) under the owner's evidence ruling, with three rounds of independent review.

expected: Measure cost per ready order against the effort model (88 model minutes per order for these 20).
lesson: For simple own-terms orders the effort model overstates per-order work by roughly an order of magnitude. These types hold about 380 model hours; the large blocks (land, unclassified, standing, CS waivers) need their own probes before their hours are cut. Keep every review and completion file inside the final packet's own folder: completion refuses a packet whose prior research changed.
result: 15 claims published (research/readiness/claims/claude-2026-10-28-spent-probe.jsonl); ready for human review 285 -> 300. Both plants caught. EO 7208 held: its APP page was harvested live and has changed, so custody cannot be shown. 4 eight-hour orders blocked (no completion record; 1921 resolution text not held). Cost: about 79 producer-minutes and 9 reviewer-minutes for all 20, including four re-runs caused by pipeline defects now fixed (about 5.5 agent-minutes per finished order, coordinator time not measured).
tried: Spent-order probe: 20 pre-1937 own-terms orders (retirement exemptions, closing days, eight-hour suspensions) through claim-kit prepare/apply, blind review with 2 planted controls, after-reveal review and completion.
